name: labs/pycroscopy__dtmicroscope
title: DTMicroscope TEM client (DTMicroscope.base.twisted_client.TEMClient)
intro: DTMicroscope TEM client (DTMicroscope.base.twisted_client.TEMClient), adapted from pycroscopy/dtmicroscope. It reads `detectors`, `microscope_status` and `vacuum`; sets `stage` and `beam_position`; runs `acquire_image` and `acquire_spectrum`. `acquire_image`: acquire a microscope image of the current field of view for a declared channel, exposure, binning and region of interest, returning an image artifact. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
